published.source: Warrior regear and rotation round, 2026-10-23: hit 9% to 8% (the 10 rating into Strength), the natural flask zone with the Flask of Natural Aggression; talents, rotation and race re-searched and kept. 20k iterations, 180s, seed 1 (was 975.3)

summary: Keeps Battle Shout up for its party, with the raid's Battle Shout off.
rotation: Pre-pull: Bloodrage and Battle Shout 3s before the pull, then Charge for 15 Rage
Pre-pull: Battle Stance, then Charge for 15 Rage
Battle Shout again with 35s of it left (about 142s in, before the execute phase), unless it lasts the fight (Forever's lasts 3 min)
Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
With 25s left, Recklessness ready and under 25 Rage: swap to Berserker Stance, and back to Battle Stance once Recklessness is out
Death Wish held for the last 36s, Recklessness in the last 25s; racials with Death Wish (Blood Fury and Berserking also at the end of the fight)
Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20s; Bloodrage under 10 Rage
Slam from 20 Rage (15s cooldown with Improved Slam), outside execute
Rend kept up outside execute; then Execute
Heroic Strike from 70 Rage, Hamstring filler from 20 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: White hit Rage scales with weapon speed (measured at level 30, assumed ×1.5 at 60).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is white hits only, and Heroic Strike counts for Unbridled Wrath.
One +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 10.9.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece not counted. It would add 8.4 vs Humanoids.
Booming Voice (5/5) does nothing because the raid has Battle Shout
Arms in Berserker Stance with Whirlwind is 10% behind.
Raid damage hits (2 a minute, about 9 Rage each) are an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec arms -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_arms -apl level60_arms_battle_shout -talents 20305213032515201-55050000001 -race Orc -duration 180, then the raid's battleShout removed (standards 23: the duty preset's own shout is the only one). Not the class default: the warrior UI has one spec page and its default Level 60 build is Fury Dual Wield; this is the only Arms preset. Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts.
